campaign_contract.campaign_mode: Narration scenes come from the YouTube rendition selected by CAMPAIGN_MANIFEST and CAMPAIGN_ITEM_ID. Measured scene_timing is written back to that same Artifact.
campaign_contract.legacy_scenarios: The b/c text below exists only for private template regression checks and is never a campaign source.

message_hierarchy.company_promise: Help an established business pursue roughly 2x the output at half the operating cost, one workflow at a time.
message_hierarchy.rule: Choose one topic-specific idea per video. Every title, scene, narration line, and CTA must support it and connect naturally to the company promise without repeating the same headline mechanically.
message_hierarchy.scenario_b_topic: Disconnected AI tools need one operating system before they can work as a team.
message_hierarchy.scenario_c_topic: A real AI department is built by defining roles, context, standards, and workflows.

tone_contract.gender: masculine. ALWAYS. No female voices, no ambiguous voices, no exceptions.
tone_contract.style: Active, very confident, demanding, aggressive but friendly. Professional AND casual — NOT formal at all. He knows exactly what he is doing and saying, with 10000% confidence.
tone_contract.copywriting: Proper short sentences, deliberate pauses, viral-style titles. Every word makes the viewer curious about the next one. Proper flow, proper video scenarios.
tone_contract.pace: Slow enough that the voice covers the full sentence within its scene. A readable visual lead establishes the frame before speech, and a post-speech hold lets the idea land. Scene timing derives from MEASURED spoken clip durations and minimum visual dwell. NEVER cut a sentence, never atempo-fit, never squeeze the work into a hardcoded duration.
tone_contract.persona_consistency: One consistent persona across every clip, both scenarios, all providers. Each provider picks the masculine voice that best matches this persona; the result must sound like the same guy.

voice_direction: Synthesize the spoken transcript only. A deep, grounded, low-register adult MALE narrator. Active, very confident, demanding, aggressive but friendly; professional AND casual — absolutely NOT formal. Short punchy sentences with deliberate pauses; every word should make the listener curious about the next one. He knows exactly what he is doing and saying. Deliver at a measured pace — slow enough that the full sentence lands inside its scene; never rush, never cut a word, and finish the final URL line completely: spielos dot xyz slash services.
quality_gates: The video communicates one topic-specific idea connected to the company promise.

Every clip in BOTH scenarios uses the exact same pinned persona voice (voice_selection) — one consistent guy across every clip and both scenarios; no mixed generations, no auditions, no ambiguous voices.
Each line plays in full: scene timing is derived from measured spoken clip durations plus readable visual lead and hold, never from fixed windows that trim mid-sentence.
Each line earns a visual change; no narration merely restates on-screen copy.
The final audio is narration-only: no music bed in the mix or in the spec.
Provider fallback is deterministic (gemini -> mistral -> cartesia -> elevenlabs); a provider change restarts the whole scenario — the voice never changes mid-scenario.
The spoken URL is human-readable, not read as punctuation.
The final file contains both video and audio streams.
Every source narration clip is audible and its identity matches the campaign item before delivery.
The hook thumbnail is captured only after its full title composition is visible.
Campaign video, thumbnail, and QA report live together beneath the campaign batch artifact tree.
Final mix is checked on headphones and phone speaker.
